run_calculate_runner: run a CalculateRunner to execute an ASE calculator and save results to a results directory
implement_calculate_method: implement the abstract calculate method in a subclass to run ASE calculator predictions on input data
implement_write_results_method: implement the abstract write_results method in a subclass to save calculation results to a directory
load_state_from_checkpoint: load a previously saved calculation state from a checkpoint directory to resume an interrupted job
create_calculate_runner_subclass: create a subclass of CalculateRunner that implements calculate and write_results for a custom ASE calculator
